<thought>Based on the measured resistances, the nodes form a simple series chain: A – X1 – N_b1 – N_b2 – N_b3 – B. The measured values match a series of five resistors:
- R1 (A‑X1) = 6.667 Ω
- R2 (X1‑N_b1) = 5 Ω
- R3 (N_b1‑N_b2) = 10 Ω
- R4 (N_b2‑N_b3) = 15 Ω
- R5 (N_b3‑B) = 20 Ω

All other node‑to‑node resistances are sums of these series values, confirming the topology.
